title: 666. Maximum Average Subarray II

examples.explanation: The length-4 block [12,-5,-6,50] averages 12.75, beating every longer block.
With minimum length 1 the best block is the single largest element.

hints: This is a portable adaptation: return the average as a finite, double-parseable decimal string.
Binary-search the answer: for a candidate mid, check whether any block of length >= k in (nums[i] - mid) has a non-negative sum.
The check uses prefix sums with the smallest prefix seen at least k steps back; about 50 iterations settle 1e-5 precision.
